name: selected_route_id
description: Id for selected_route. Logical primary key. Format: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$, length 4-63.

name: display_name
description: User provided name for the route. Non-unique; for human readability in reports.

name: speed_reading_intervals
description: Legacy intervals representing road density across the route. Deprecated in favor of speed_reading_offsets; may stop being populated on or after Jan 13, 2027.

fields.name: interval_coordinates
fields.description: The coordinates on the polyline for the speed reading interval.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude coordinate of a coordinate within speed reading interval.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude coordinate of a coordinate within speed reading interval.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Describes the categorized current speed of road conditions. Possible values: NORMAL, SLOW, TRAFFIC_JAM.

name: travel_duration
description: Legacy travel time information message block. Deprecated in favor of top-level duration_in_seconds and static_duration_in_seconds; may stop being populated on or after Jan 13, 2027.

fields.name: duration_in_seconds
fields.description: The duration of travel through the route based on current road conditions. Bounded >= 0.0.

fields.name: static_duration_in_seconds
fields.description: The duration of travel through the route without taking road conditions into consideration. Bounded > 0.0.

name: retrieval_time
description: Legacy time the road data was collected, represented as custom Timestamp (seconds/nanos). Deprecated in favor of retrieval_timestamp; may stop being populated on or after Jan 13, 2027.

fields.name: seconds
fields.description: Represents seconds of UTC time since Unix epoch.

fields.name: nanos
fields.description: Non-negative fractions of a second at nanosecond resolution.

name: route_geometry
description: Contains a geojson polyline representing the optimal route determined based on user's input waypoints.

name: road_segment_ids
description: Place IDs along the route in topological order indicating connected road segments.

name: speed_reading_offsets
description: Speed reading intervals defined by linear distance offsets along the route polyline. Omitted when has_road_closure is true.

fields.name: start_offset
fields.description: Starting offset in meters from the beginning of the route (inclusive).

fields.name: end_offset
fields.description: Ending offset in meters from the beginning of the route (exclusive; equals start_offset of subsequent interval).

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Categorized traffic speed condition. Possible values: NORMAL, SLOW, TRAFFIC_JAM, TRAFFIC_JAM_HEAVY.

name: duration_in_seconds
description: The duration of travel through the route based on current road conditions in seconds. Omitted when has_road_closure is true.

name: static_duration_in_seconds
description: The duration of travel through the route without taking road conditions into consideration in seconds (free-flow baseline).

name: retrieval_timestamp
description: RFC 3339 formatted UTC timestamp string indicating when the road data was retrieved (e.g. 2026-10-08T15:04:05+00:00).

name: has_road_closure
description: Indicates whether the route is currently subject to a full road closure. When true, duration_in_seconds and speed_reading_offsets are omitted.

name: subscription_name
description: Pub/Sub subscription metadata: Name of the subscription that delivered the message.

name: message_id
description: Pub/Sub subscription metadata: Unique identifier of the delivered message, useful for deduplication.

name: publish_time
description: Pub/Sub subscription metadata: UTC timestamp representing when the message was published to the topic. Highly recommended as a BigQuery partitioning column.

name: attributes
description: Pub/Sub subscription metadata: JSON-formatted string of any user-defined message attributes.
